anna: Quick sanity check — planning a sidebar regroup: Resource (Models, Datasets, Secrets), Deploy (Endpoints, Rollouts), Inspect (Logs, Metrics). Main concerns: permalink stability & deep-linking semantics when we change tabs. Example urls: `/console/models/:id` vs `/console/models/:id?tab=deployments`. Which should be canonical for sharing?

james-p: I vote for path segments (`/models/:id/deployments`) — nicer for copy/paste and history. Query params are fine but harder to link directly to nested subviews. Downsides: more routes to maintain. Could add redirects from old query-param links. :+1:

marco-d: path segments aligns with IA, but left-nav highlight logic gets trickier for nested routes (we need a stable route->nav mapping). Also breadcrumb behaviour: should read "Models > <Model name> > Deployments" and each crumb should be a shareable link. Accessibility: when landing via deep link, focus must move to the main heading and we should expose a visible skip link.

evie-eng: Implementing redirects from `?tab=` -> `/.../tab` is straightforward. Router needs dedupe to avoid double renders. Also: telemetry — record original incoming URL so rollouts/experiments don't misattribute users. Dev note: avoid heavy client-side redirects on initial load to keep SSR bounce low.

anna: quick routing sketch: 
```
/console/models/:modelId -> Models > Model > Overview
/console/models/:modelId/deployments -> Models > Model > Deployments
/console/models/:modelId/versions/:versionId -> Models > Model > Version
```
Use these as canonical share URLs; map legacy `?tab=` to redirects.

james-p: copy nits: breadcrumb labels should be friendly — use "Model details" instead of just "Model". Also swap any internal "master" labels to "primary" before we ship.

marco-d: a11y nitlist: ensure `aria-current=\"page\"` on active nav items, keyboard order matches visual order, skip-to-content visible on focus, ensure open/close of sidebar doesn't trap focus unexpectedly. For announcements: use `aria-live=\"polite\"` for route-change summaries only.

console-bot: deploy scheduled: branch `nav-a11y-fixes` -> staging on 2026-04-01T02:00:00Z.

anna: perfect — I'll update the wireframes with path-segment examples, add the breadcrumb copy suggestions, and drop a small a11y checklist for eng. Will post a follow-up with updated flows. :thumbsup:
